The general Sallow deployment approval policy uses a service owner as the approver. This applies to Sallow jobs that have no documented project-specific exception.

# Sallow deployment approval exception
The Sallow Ledger project requires the security lead to approve a deployment instead of the service owner. This exception only applies to Ledger; the general Sallow approval rule is unchanged.

# Wren mill

The Wren mill checklist starts with the crossbench inspection and ends with the operator acknowledging receipt. The inspection record contains the run tag, work order, supervisor name, gate position, and clock reading. The operator mounts the record to the reference board and notifies the west shift at the end of review. Temporary notes stay in the control cabinet until the signed record arrives. Every inspection is indexed by the date printed on the original work order.

A worn drive collar was suspected initially but never established as the cause of the Wren mill stop.
